decision.observation: Recovery succeeded: 10 mph, gear 1, all dots pale. Car centred on the gravel, road ahead runs up-frame and bends gently left toward a distant right-hand curve, white posts along both verges, pines on either side.
decision.hypothesis: Centred on clear gravel with a wide lane — sustained plain throttle should build speed along this straight without needing steering.
decision.memory: W+D for 1.2 s brought the car from open grass back onto the gravel (7 to 10 mph) and it is now centred. Plain W on centred gravel typically adds 3-5 mph per beat.
